selections.rationale: Specific alliance leadership, architecture patterns, industry context, and quantified growth create a concise, credible enterprise outcome.
Grounded solution-leadership scope and technical methods support enterprise credibility, though the connection between HPC testing and portfolio expansion is somewhat compressed.
Clearly links financial-services discovery, data modeling, BI, buyer priorities, and delivery handoffs without overstating unsupported platform capabilities.
Enterprise solution ownership and governed architecture are credible, but the line is dense and its executive-decision outcome is broad.
Strong partner-facing architecture and co-sell relevance with disciplined terminology, though it emphasizes coordinated activity more than a distinct measured outcome.
